name: WearHouse Clothing Co.
old_description: Modern Boho Book Nerd Crewneck Sweatshirt | Cozy Reader Apparel
about:
WearHouse Clothing Co. operates from Princeton, West Virginia. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom decoration services including embroidery, screen printing, and vinyl application. It accepts custom orders and maintains a catalog of ready-to-ship items such as graphic tees, crewneck sweatshirts, candles, bags, books, drinkware, housewares, and collectibles. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The company serves schools, sports organizations, and retail customers. Examples from its catalog include band and spirit wear for Princeton Senior High School, rivalry football apparel for Mercer County, and teacher-themed Valentine's Day shirts. It also sells West Virginia–themed novelty items such as pepperoni roll and Mothman graphics.

The company has not published a stated mission or differentiation beyond offering a full line of decoration services and immediate-delivery products.

name: Wearhouse Middletown Custom T-Shirts & Apparel
about:
Wearhouse operates from a facility in Middletown, Connecticut. The company runs as a local print shop serving businesses and organizations throughout the region. No founding year or ownership structure is disclosed in public materials.

The shop provides a range of garment decoration services including screen printing, direct-to-garment (DTG) printing, direct-to-film (DTF) printing, embroidery, laser engraving, sublimation, and cylindrical printing. It sources blank apparel from an in-house catalog—brands such as Tultex, Next Level, Bella+Canvas, and polyester performance tees—and does not accept customer-supplied garments. The team also offers artwork cleanup and preparation to ensure print-ready files. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

Wearhouse works with a mix of commercial, institutional, and event-based clients. Examples include The Flood Law Firm (legal), Crossfit Ironworks Higganum (fitness), Nick Strong 5K Run (event fundraising), Two Brothers Moving (logistics), Middletown Park & Rec (municipal recreation), and the Herricks Debate Team (education). Orders range from company-branded uniforms and promotional merchandise to custom jerseys for youth leagues and event-specific tees.

The company emphasizes a full-service model under one roof: multiple decoration methods, a curated blank catalog, artwork support, and local pickup by appointment. Its policy of declining outside garments is framed as a quality-control measure, while the artwork service aims to prevent production issues. Customers have noted quick turnaround times for holiday rushes, though the shop does not publish standard lead times.

name: Wegner Custom Furniture
old_description: Wegner Custom Furniture is an award winning custom furniture company that has been helping home owners, designers and custom home builders bring their custom furniture vision to life since 2015.
about:
Wegner Custom Furniture was founded in 2015 by Joe Wegner in Huntington Beach, California, before relocating to Conifer, Colorado in February 2017. The company, owned and operated by Wegner, grew from a backyard project building a bed and dining table into a full-time custom furniture business after early Craigslist orders demonstrated demand. In August 2024, the operation expanded to the Big Sky, Montana area.

The shop produces handcrafted wood furniture including dining tables, conference tables, coffee tables, pedestal tables, double-leaf extension tables, built-in bunk beds, and custom beds. Working primarily in hickory and reclaimed timber, the team handles design, joinery, finishing, and assembly for one-off residential pieces and commercial projects. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

Clients range from homeowners and interior designers to custom home builders across Colorado, Idaho, Wisconsin, Montana, Minnesota, California, Maryland, Texas, and New Mexico. The company also furnishes professional spaces such as offices with custom conference tables.

Wegner emphasizes exceeding customer expectations, citing frequent feedback that pieces turn out better than envisioned. The founder’s background in exercise science and a high-school woodworking class inform a design approach that blends structural rigor with aesthetic warmth.

name: Weidmann Electrical Technology
old_description: Powering transformer innovation with trusted insulation solutions
about:
Weidmann Electrical Technology is headquartered in St Johnsbury, Vermont. The company traces its origins to 1877, when it began as a manufacturer of electrical insulation. Today it operates as a global group with a 145-year history of innovation in transformer insulation.

The company produces specialized insulation technology and accessories for power transformers, including its signature Transformerboard, invented in 1937 and regarded as an industry standard. With 18 strategic facilities across 10 countries and a workforce of over 3,000, Weidmann ships more than 5 million products annually and generates annual revenue exceeding CHF 500 million. Its engineering teams collaborate with customers worldwide to develop custom insulation solutions for demanding applications.

Weidmann serves the energy sector, transformer manufacturers, and the railway industry, providing custom-designed solutions for traction transformers that emphasize efficiency and sustainability. The company also operates in electrical, medical, and fiber-optic markets, supporting critical infrastructure in more than 80 countries.

Weidmann differentiates itself through its long-standing expertise in transformer insulation, a global footprint that enables local support, and a sustainability strategy aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals and recognized by Ecovadis ratings. The firm emphasizes innovation with purpose, quality, and compliance as core to its partnerships.

name: Weiss Sheet Metal
old_description: With roots spanning back to 1934, Weiss Sheet Metal knows a thing or two about how to satisfy customers with quality products and stunning results. We provide stainless steel custom fabrication
about:
Weiss Sheet Metal operates from Avon, Massachusetts, where it was founded in 1934. The family-owned business has served the New England region for nearly nine decades, building a reputation for custom sheet metal fabrication.

The company specializes in stainless steel, aluminum, brass, and copper fabrication for residential, commercial, and architectural projects. Its 27,000-square-foot facility houses in-house shearing and bending capacity for 12-foot sheets, along with laser cutting, water jet cutting, punching, forming, welding, and polishing. The shop handles orders ranging from single pieces to 1,000-unit runs and provides design support via SolidWorks and AutoCAD.

Customers include homeowners, contractors, and institutions across sectors such as food service, laboratories, stadiums, and high-end residential kitchens. Projects have encompassed exhaust hoods, work tables, custom cabinetry, column covers, sunscreens, and bollards for clients throughout Massachusetts and surrounding states.

Weiss Sheet Metal emphasizes its family-owned, hands-on approach and a team with over 200 years of combined experience. The company cites its ability to deliver invisible welds through butt welding and polishing, on-request shop drawings, and direct job-site delivery as key differentiators.

name: Wells Wood Turning & Finishing
old_description: Wells Wood Turning is a highly experienced manufacturer of wood
about:
Wells Wood Turning & Finishing operates from a mill in Buckfield, Maine. The company has produced souvenir mini baseball bats for 25 years, though its founding year is not publicly stated. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed.

The shop turns custom wood components on traditional back knife lathes and finishes them on rotary sanders. Core products include mini bats (1.25-inch barrel, 18 inches long) made from yellow birch, plus rolling pins, tool handles, furniture components, craft parts, drinkware, and promotional items such as Easter eggs. Finishing options cover water-based varnish and paint; personalization uses single-color pad printing or laser engraving. The facility handles high-volume runs and national campaigns.

Customers span Major and Minor League baseball suppliers, Little League organizations, promotional-products distributors, brokers, and civic groups. All raw lumber is sourced from North American sawmills.

The company emphasizes domestic production and sustainable sourcing, positioning itself as a contract manufacturer for wholesale partners seeking made-in-USA wood turnings.

name: Wendling Sheet Metal & Mech
old_description: Sometimes it takes a specially trained company and employees to complete projects of this form.
about:
Wendling Sheet Metal & Mech operates from Saginaw, Michigan. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

The firm runs a state-of-the-art sheet metal fabrication shop staffed by CAD designers, fabricators, welders, job-site inspectors, and expert installers. Its core services include architectural metal fabrication, industrial ventilation system fabrication, shields and guards, specialty sheet metal fabrication, and welding. The shop handles composite panel systems, standing seam roofing, metal siding, and architectural metal arts, offering both fabrication and on-site installation. Project experience spans a Veterans Administration complex (composite panels, standing seam roofing, metal sidings, architectural arts), the Bay City Planetarium (composite panel replacement and resealing), and Bay City Power sites (rework and completion of lagging installations).

The company serves industrial manufacturing clients as well as government, education, and utility sectors. Concrete customers include the Veterans Administration, the Bay City Planetarium, and Bay City Power.

Wendling emphasizes that its combination of in-house design, inspection, and installation teams gives it the unique capability to customize each project to customer specifications. It states that work is done on time, done right, and safely the first time, and that it is one of few area firms able to compete in both small and large market projects.

name: Wepco Plastics, Inc.
old_description: Providing high quality prototyping services for over 37 years
about:
Wepco Plastics, Inc. has operated from Middlefield, Connecticut, for more than 35 years. The company traces its roots to founder Waldo Parmelee, who started the business with a single toolmaker. Today it remains family-owned, with leadership including President David Parmelee and Vice Presidents Amanda Wiriya and Jeff Maier.

The shop specializes in prototype and short-to-medium-run plastic injection molding, backed by in-house tooling that enables a three-week tooling turnaround. Capabilities extend to 4-axis aerospace machining, fixturing, secondary operations, 3D printing for fit and function testing, design collaboration, light assembly, insert molding, and overmolding. The facility employs over 30 people and stands behind a 50,000-part guarantee on its molds.

Wepco serves more than ten industries across the greater New England region, delivering parts from concept through production. Customers rely on the company for a one-stop workflow that covers design, rapid prototyping, mold manufacturing, and injection molding.

The company’s stated differentiators are its family-owned structure, American-made production, a 50,000-part mold guarantee, and a three-week tooling lead time. Leadership emphasizes four core values—doing the right thing, continuous improvement, community impact, and exceeding expectations—while investing in training, data-driven process improvement, and the latest technologies to remain a quintessential partner.
